title: singular Evaluation-Gate Review Evidence
description: Independent review evidence for a `kind: evaluation` DAG node whose `authority` is agent-review-allowed. Written to docs/orchestration/gates/evidence/<node>.review.json; promote-gate validates it (verdict pass, node match, evidenceRefs exist, headSha an ancestor of the target head, age within SINGULAR_REVIEW_MAX_AGE_HOURS) before recording an agent-review gate result. Operator promotion (promote-gate --operator) never requires this file.
